name: T2I-Generation-Paper-List
description: Tracking the latest and greatest research papers on text-to-image generation.

paragraphs: A curated collection of papers, models, and resources for the field of Text-to-Image Generation.

This repository is proudly maintained by the frontline research mentors at QuenithAI (应达学术). It aims to provide the most comprehensive and cutting-edge map of papers and technologies in the field of Text-to-Image generation. Your contributions are also vital—feel free to open an issue or submit a pull request to become a collaborator of this repository. We expect your participation! If you require expert 1-on-1 guidance on your submissions to top-tier conferences and journals, we invite you to contact us via WeChat or E-mail). --- 本仓库由 「应达学术」(QuenithAI)…

QuenithAI is a professional organization composed of top researchers, dedicated to providing high-quality 1-on-1 research mentoring for university students worldwide. Our mission is to help students bridge the gap from theoretical knowledge to cutting-edge research and publish their work in top-tier conferences and journals.
